transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling Streamline Solutions, this is Alex speaking. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Alex, this is Jenna. I need help with my billing. I was charged twice this month for the Pro plan.

**Agent:** I apologize for the inconvenience, Jenna. Let me take a look at your billing history. Could you please provide me with the email associated with your account?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s jenna@example.com. I really don’t understand why this happened. 

**Agent:** Thank you for that. I’m pulling up your account now. It appears there was a glitch in our system that processed your payment twice. I can refund one of the charges for you.

**Customer:** That would be great. I was worried I’d have to dispute this. 

**Agent:** I completely understand your concern. I’ll process the refund right now, and you should see it reflected in your account within 3-5 business days.

**Customer:** Thank you! Also, is there any way I can keep track of my billing better? 

**Agent:** Absolutely! We have a new feature in our dashboard called “Billing Insights” that lets you view your billing cycle, charges, and payment history in real-time. 

**Customer:** That sounds useful. Can you tell me how to access that?

**Agent:** Sure! Once you log into the portal, you can find “Billing Insights” under the Account Settings section. You can also get notifications for upcoming charges.

**Customer:** Awesome, I’ll check it out. By the way, are there any discounts available if I upgrade to the Premium plan?

**Agent:** Currently, we’re offering a 15% discount for the first three months if you upgrade now. The Premium plan offers advanced features like analytics and priority support.

**Customer:** Nice! I’ll consider upgrading after I see the refund. 

**Agent:** That sounds like a plan. I’ll follow up with you in a few days to see if you have any more questions. 

**Customer:** Thank you for your help, Alex. You made this easy!

**Agent:** You're welcome, Jenna! I'm glad I could assist you today. Have a great day!
